Source: gpui-libghostty 0.3.1 src/adapter.rs (MIT), https://github.com/behzade/gpui-libghostty.
Only the GPUI binding macro is copied. Native code, Ghostty, and its build remain the
pinned crates.io dependency; they are not forked here.

GPUI 0.2.2 FocusHandle::focus takes only Window; upstream's newer GPUI revision takes
Window and Context. Three focus calls use the 0.2.2 signature. All native-surface safety
and lifetime handling remain upstream's code. Remove this adapter when upstream supports
this GPUI release or MR.DE upgrades to the newer GPUI signature.
